values.label: Grid operator / market region for TX
values.source_title: Electric Power Markets (RTO/ISO national overview)
values.quote: PJM ... all or part of 13 states
values.note: Operates in the state of Texas; SPP and MISO South cover small parts of Texas. Value is a flag; see field 'region'.

values.label: Grid operator / market region for VA
values.source_title: Electric Power Markets (RTO/ISO national overview)
values.quote: PJM ... all or part of 13 states
values.note: PJM covers all or part of 13 states incl. Virginia. Value is a flag; see field 'region'.

values.label: Grid operator / market region for OH
values.source_title: Electric Power Markets (RTO/ISO national overview)
values.quote: PJM ... all or part of 13 states
values.note: PJM covers all or part of Ohio. Value is a flag; see field 'region'.

values.label: Grid operator / market region for GA
values.source_title: Electric Power Markets (RTO/ISO national overview)
values.quote: PJM ... all or part of 13 states
values.note: Not in an RTO; Southeast bilateral market (Georgia Power / Southern Co.). Value is a flag; see field 'region'.

values.label: Grid operator / market region for AZ
values.source_title: Electric Power Markets (RTO/ISO national overview)
values.quote: PJM ... all or part of 13 states
values.note: Not in an RTO; Southwest region (APS, SRP); CAISO EIM serves parts of Arizona. Value is a flag; see field 'region'.

values.label: Grid operator / market region for NV
values.source_title: Electric Power Markets (RTO/ISO national overview)
values.quote: PJM ... all or part of 13 states
values.note: Not in an RTO; Northwest Power Pool / Southwest; CAISO EIM serves parts of Nevada. Value is a flag; see field 'region'.

values.label: Grid operator / market region for IL
values.source_title: Electric Power Markets (RTO/ISO national overview)
values.quote: PJM ... all or part of 13 states
values.note: PJM (ComEd, north) and MISO (south) both cover Illinois; FERC lists Illinois under PJM. Value is a flag; see field 'region'.

values.source_title: Electric Power Markets (RTO/ISO national overview)
values.quote: PJM ... all or part of 13 states

values.source_title: Electric Power Markets (RTO/ISO national overview)

values.label: Grid operator / market region for IA
values.source_title: Electric Power Markets (RTO/ISO national overview)
values.quote: PJM ... all or part of 13 states
values.note: FERC lists Iowa under SPP's 14-state transmission footprint; MISO covers most Iowa load (MidAmerican, Alliant). Mixed. Value is a flag; see field 'region'.

values.label: Grid operator / market region for WY
values.source_title: Electric Power Markets (RTO/ISO national overview)
values.quote: PJM ... all or part of 13 states
values.note: FERC lists Wyoming under SPP footprint (portions) and Northwest Power Pool; CAISO EIM serves parts. Mixed. Value is a flag; see field 'region'.

values.label: Grid operator / market region for ND
values.source_title: Electric Power Markets (RTO/ISO national overview)
values.quote: PJM ... all or part of 13 states
values.note: FERC lists North Dakota under SPP (portions); MISO covers eastern ND. Mixed. Value is a flag; see field 'region'.

values.note: FERC lists NC under PJM (portions, Dominion NC) and Southeast bilateral market (Duke). Mixed. Value is a flag; see field 'region'.

values.quote: PJM ... all or part of 13 states
